sloka: कृत कौतुक सर्वस्वा वेदि मूलम् उपागताः ।मम कन्या मुनिश्रेष्ठ दीप्ता वह्नेः इव अर्चिषः ॥१-७३-१५॥
transliteration: kṛta kautuka sarvasvā vedi mūlam upāgatāḥ ।mama kanyā muniśreṣṭha dīptā vahneḥ iva arciṣaḥ ॥1-73-15॥

translations.english: O Best of ascetics my daughters have performed all the rites relating to marriage. They (now) stand at the foot of the altar shining like the bright flames of fire.
